name: UC Berkeley
summary: UC Berkeley, founded in 1868, is the founding campus of the University of California. It is test-free — SAT and ACT scores are not used in admission or scholarships. Computer Science admits students directly into the College of Computing, Data Science, and Society, while Economics is declared after completing prerequisite courses.

applicationPlatform.value: UC Application (one application for all UC campuses)

testing.notes: Berkeley calls this "test-free": scores are not used for review, selection or scholarships.

english.waiver: Three or more years of schooling with English as the language of instruction

internationalTuition.notes: Tuition US$7,101 plus Nonresident Supplemental Tuition US$19,635 per semester (2026-27 cohort), two semesters; campus fees extra. International students also pay a US$100 service fee from fall 2026.

domesticTuition.notes: California residents: tuition US$7,101 per semester (2026-27 cohort); campus fees extra.

scholarships.name: International Leaders Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Admitted international undergraduates with academic excellence and leadership; considered automatically.
scholarships.coverage: Need-based assistance for up to four years

scholarships.name: Regents' and Chancellor's Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Berkeley's most prestigious undergraduate scholarship, for students showing creativity, leadership and service; admitted students are considered automatically.

housing.value: New first-years in 2026-27 have a two-year housing guarantee if they meet all deadlines; about 96% of first-years live on campus.

admissionProcess.detail: Apply between 1 October and 30 November 2026 for fall 2027; select Berkeley and your major.
Applications are reviewed holistically without SAT/ACT scores.
TOEFL 90, IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 115 — or three years of English-medium schooling.
Fall 2027 decisions are released between 1 and 31 March 2027.

feeBreakdown.notes: Assessed from fall 2026; how often it is billed was not confirmed.
